function.name: roll_dice
function.description: Roll a dice expression and return the total. Use this for ANY random outcome (damage, ability dice, percentile, loot dice). Never invent dice results yourself.

advantage.description: 0 normal, 1 advantage (roll twice keep higher total), -1 disadvantage.

function.name: roll_check
function.description: Resolve a check / saving throw / attack roll: rolls the die, adds a modifier, and compares to a difficulty class (DC). Returns natural roll, total, success, margin, and critical flags. Use for every adjudicated roll against a target number.

modifier.description: Total bonus/penalty added to the roll.

dc.description: Difficulty class / target number to beat (>=). Omit for a raw roll.

die.description: Resolution die for the chosen system. Default '1d20'.

function.name: encounter_start
function.description: Begin a combat/initiative encounter, clearing any previous one.

function.name: encounter_end
function.description: End the current combat encounter and clear the initiative tracker.

function.name: combat_status
function.description: Return the current encounter: round, whose turn it is, and initiative order with HP/conditions.

function.name: combatant_add
function.description: Add a combatant to the active encounter. If 'initiative' is omitted, the engine rolls initiative using 'init_mod'. Returns the updated initiative order.

function.name: turn_next
function.description: Advance to the next combatant's turn, wrapping to a new round when the order completes. Returns the current combatant and round number.

function.name: apply_damage
function.description: Apply damage to a character/combatant. Temporary HP absorbs first; marks 'down' when HP reaches 0. Syncs both the character sheet and combat entry.

function.name: heal
function.description: Restore hit points to a character/combatant, capped at max_hp.

function.name: condition_add
function.description: Apply a status condition (e.g. poisoned, prone, frightened) to a character/combatant.

function.name: condition_clear
function.description: Remove a status condition from a character/combatant.

function.name: character_set
function.description: Create or update a character sheet. 'fields' is a free-form object; common keys: max_hp, hp, temp_hp, ac, level, and a nested 'stats' object for ability scores/skills. Numbers are stored exactly.

function.name: character_get
function.description: Fetch a character's full sheet (HP, conditions, inventory, stats).

function.name: var_set
function.description: Set a campaign variable for persistent world/plot state (e.g. quest_stage, faction_reputation, day_count).

function.name: table_roll
function.description: Roll on a random table. Pass 'entries' to define/overwrite a named table; thereafter the name alone re-rolls it. Returns the rolled index and result.

entries.description: Table contents; one entry is chosen uniformly at random.
